_note: 20261015 mapping: mobile_2 alone builds its own map. dataset.bag is mobile_2's retimed bag (no merge: it holds every topic and its TF, the LiDAR-camera calibration included); GLIM's traj_lidar.txt next to it in mobile_2/glim/. 01 seed -> 02 refine -> 02b BA (traj_lidar_ba.txt: thinnest walls of GLIM / 02 / BA on 02 / BA on GLIM, wall_build) -> 01 map, fused as a TSDF (coloured from the raw RealSense image, undistorted) -> 05 boards anchor the map -> 10 poses. No 07/08: no other cameras in this pass.

01_build_map._note: 2 cm, not mapping_A's 1 cm: 543 m of drive at 1 cm passed 10 GB by scan 11000 of 13903 and was killed; 02 thins its reference to 5 cm anyway, and 2 cm is finer than the Ouster's noise

tsdf._note: trunc = 3 sigma of where the scans put a wall: wall_build on traj_lidar_ba.txt, whole run 8.4 cm (5-95 %) -> sigma 8.4 / 3.29 = 2.55 cm -> 7.7 cm; >= 3 cells of 2 cm. min_weight 3: a cell seen by fewer rays is a stray hit.
